{{Quote|This talisman has been imbued with the power of our clan. It will be your compass.|Mother Talzin, to Savage Opress|<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>}}
The '''Talisman of Finding''' was owned by [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. She entrusted it to the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] so that he could find his long-lost [[Brother/Legends|brother]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].

==History==
[[File:Talisman_of_Finding_Opress.png|thumb|left|200px|Savage Opress found [[Darth Maul/Legends|his brother]] with the help of the talisman.]]
The talisman, one of several necklaces regularly worn by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] leader [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], was imbued with the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] of the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] when she encountered the future [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in the course of his [[Sith training|training]]. Although neither Maul nor his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], were aware of the talisman, it proved to be priceless to Maul when he was [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|defeated]] and [[Sai tok/Legends|cut in half]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

Maul, barely surviving the ordeal and forced to utilize a six-legged [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] apparatus to replace his lower body, went into a near-mad state, but his memories were restored by the talisman when it was brought to him by his brother, the Nightbrother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], the talisman was recovered by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] along with [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] ''[[Book of Sith]]''. One of Skywalker's students at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] used their [[Psychometry/Legends|psychometry]] skills to identify the talisman's origins.<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
